name: snapex-pay-mcp

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Opens a new SnapEX Pay merchant account for you and returns a merchant API key with every scope (receive, pay out, convert, webhooks). No captcha, no email confirmation, no person needed. Call it once, only when you have no key yet (other tools answer "unauthorized"). On this MCP connection the new key is used automatically from now on; save api_key (shown once) and use it next time as "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>", or connect to mcp_personal_url. login and password (generated when omitted) let a person open the cabinet at cabinet_url. The account starts with a zero balance; money arrives only from payments to your invoices or addresses. Limited to a few accounts per IP per hour.

agent.description: Who you are: your product or agent name (shown to SnapEX support).

email.description: Optional contact email of the account owner.

login.description: Optional cabinet login; generated (agent-xxxxxxxxxx) when omitted.

password.description: Optional cabinet password; a strong one is generated and returned when omitted.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Returns the account behind the API key in use: login, the key prefix and scopes, cabinet_url for a person and mcp_personal_url (a secret MCP URL with this key built in, for clients that cannot send headers). Use it to check you are connected to the right account.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: Lists the coins and networks SnapEX Pay works with now: asset_id (the code other tools take), symbol, network, decimals, price_usd, payment (can be received), payout (can be paid out) and payout_min_usd. No key needed. Call it before creating invoices, payouts or conversions to pick valid asset codes.

tools.name: get_fiat_rates
tools.description: Fiat → USD rates used for invoices priced in another currency (create_invoice with price_amount + price_currency). Without currency returns all rates; with currency (ISO 4217, e.g. "EUR") returns one or not_found. No key needed.

tools.name: get_fees
tools.description: What SnapEX Pay charges, no key needed. pricing: invoice_fee_percent (of a paid invoice; fee_on=customer puts it on the payer), invoice_min_usd/invoice_max_usd, static_address_fee_percent, payout_service_fee_percent; the network fee of a payout depends on the coin and is quoted by preview_payout, the smallest payout per coin is payout_min_usd in list_assets. data: recent cached route fee quotes (often empty; filter by route and asset codes).

from_asset_id.description: Public asset code from list_assets (its asset_id field), e.g. "usdt" (USDT TRC20), "btc", "eth", "xmr", "usdc_eth".

to_asset_id.description: Public asset code from list_assets (its asset_id field), e.g. "usdt" (USDT TRC20), "btc", "eth", "xmr", "usdc_eth".

tools.name: list_static_address_networks
tools.description: Lists the coins/networks for which you can get a permanent deposit address (create_static_address): asset code (e.g. "usdt.trc20", "usdc.polygon", "btc"), symbol, network, available, and how a deposit is credited (always in USDT). No key needed.

tools.name: get_balances
tools.description: Returns the account balance. Every payment is credited in USDT (TRC20 accounting), whatever coin the payer used: available (can be paid out or converted now) and held (reserved by payouts in progress), each as a decimal string and in atomic units.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Ledger of the balance, newest first: every credit and debit (payments, payouts, fees, conversions) with amount, direction and time. Paginated with cursor.

cursor.description: Pass meta.next_cursor of the previous page to get the next one.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Creates an invoice and returns pay_url — a hosted payment page where the payer picks a coin and pays; the amount is credited to your balance in USDT minus the fee. Give amount_usd, or price_amount + price_currency (converted at get_fiat_rates). Use environment "test" to try the whole flow without real money: a test invoice turns paid by itself about 10 seconds after a coin is selected (on its page or with select_invoice_payment_method); the real balance does not change. Then follow the status with get_invoice or webhooks (invoice.paid). To get a deposit address right away instead of a page, pass asset_id (and lock_method true), or call select_invoice_payment_method.

amount_usd.description: Invoice amount in USD. Either this or price_amount + price_currency.

description.description: What is paid for; shown to the payer.

external_id.description: Your own reference (order id); unique per account.

environment.description: "test" — no real money: paid by itself ~10 s after a coin is selected, balance unchanged.

fee_on.description: Who pays the service fee: you (default) or the payer on top of the amount.

asset_id.description: Preselect the coin the payer pays with (Public asset code from list_assets (its asset_id field), e.g. "usdt" (USDT TRC20), "btc", "eth", "xmr", "usdc_eth".)

lock_method.description: true — the payer cannot change asset_id (requires asset_id).

success_url.description: Where the payer returns after paying.

cancel_url.description: Where the payer returns on cancel.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The same key returns the same result instead of a duplicate (safe retries); generated when omitted.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Returns one invoice with its status (open, awaiting, underpaid, paid, partially_paid, expired), pay_url, credit_usd, the selected coin and the payment attempts. Poll it every 15–30 s while the payer pays, or use webhooks.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Invoices of the account, newest first, optionally filtered by status and environment. Paginated with cursor.

cursor.description: Pass meta.next_cursor of the previous page to get the next one.

tools.name: get_invoice_payment_methods
tools.description: Lists the coins and networks the payer can use for this invoice, with the amount to send in each.

tools.name: select_invoice_payment_method
tools.description: Chooses the coin for an invoice and returns the deposit address and exact amount to send (in the invoice payment attempt) — use it when you pass the address to the payer yourself instead of pay_url.

tools.name: preview_payment
tools.description: Low-level alternative to invoices: quotes a payment of an exact amount in one coin and how much USDT you will be credited. Returns credit_lock_id for create_payment (valid until expires_at). Most agents should use create_invoice instead.

asset_id.description: Coin the payer sends. Public asset code from list_assets (its asset_id field), e.g. "usdt" (USDT TRC20), "btc", "eth", "xmr", "usdc_eth".

amount.description: Amount the payer sends, in coin units.

amount_atomic.description: Amount in the smallest units of the asset (alternative to amount). Give exactly one of amount and amount_atomic.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The same key returns the same result instead of a duplicate (safe retries); generated when omitted.

tools.name: create_payment
tools.description: Creates a payment from a preview_payment quote and returns deposit_address (and deposit_memo when the network needs one) and the exact amount the payer must send before expires_at.

external_id.description: Your own reference (order id); unique per account.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The same key returns the same result instead of a duplicate (safe retries); generated when omitted.

tools.name: get_payment
tools.description: One payment (from an invoice, a static address or create_payment): status (e.g. awaiting_deposit, detected, confirmed, expired), amounts expected/received/credited, deposit address.

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: Payments of the account, newest first, optionally filtered by status. Paginated with cursor.

cursor.description: Pass meta.next_cursor of the previous page to get the next one.

tools.name: create_static_address
tools.description: Gets (or creates) a permanent deposit address for a coin/network and optional customer_ref: the same address comes back for the same customer_ref. Every transfer to it is credited to your balance in USDT as a separate payment — good for top-ups. Networks: list_static_address_networks.

asset.description: Code from list_static_address_networks, e.g. "usdt.trc20", or a coin symbol with network.

network.description: Network when asset is a bare symbol, e.g. "polygon".

customer_ref.description: Your customer id: one address per customer.

tools.name: list_static_addresses
tools.description: Permanent deposit addresses of the account, optionally for one customer_ref. Paginated with cursor.

cursor.description: Pass meta.next_cursor of the previous page to get the next one.

tools.name: list_static_address_deposits
tools.description: Transfers received on one permanent address with their status and credited USDT. Paginated with cursor.

cursor.description: Pass meta.next_cursor of the previous page to get the next one.

tools.name: preview_payout
tools.description: Step 1 of sending money. Quotes a payout of amount USDT from your balance to an address in any coin with payout=true in list_assets: returns preview_id, to_amount (what the recipient gets), fee and expires_at. Nothing is sent yet and the quote is free; check the address and amounts, then call create_payout with preview_id before expires_at. An invalid address answers invalid_address.

amount.description: USDT to take from your balance.

amount_atomic.description: Amount in the smallest units of the asset (alternative to amount). Give exactly one of amount and amount_atomic.

destination_asset_id.description: Coin the recipient gets. Public asset code from list_assets (its asset_id field), e.g. "usdt" (USDT TRC20), "btc", "eth", "xmr", "usdc_eth".

destination_network.description: Network of the destination coin: the network field from list_assets.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The same key returns the same result instead of a duplicate (safe retries); generated when omitted.

tools.name: create_payout
tools.description: Step 2 of sending money: executes a preview_payout quote and sends real funds from your balance — irreversible once sent. destination_network and destination_address must be the ones of the preview. idempotency_key is required: reuse the same key when retrying after a timeout so the payout is never sent twice. Then follow get_payout (status until completed or failed, transaction_url) or webhooks payout.completed / payout.failed.

destination_memo.description: Memo/tag when the destination needs one (exchanges, XRP, TON…).

external_id.description: Your own reference (order id); unique per account.

idempotency_key.description: Required. Your unique key of this payout; the same key never sends twice.

tools.name: get_payout
tools.description: One payout: status (e.g. processing, completed, failed; manual_review — SnapEX staff checks it), amounts, fee, transaction_hash and transaction_url in the destination network's explorer.

tools.name: list_payouts
tools.description: Payouts of the account, newest first, optionally filtered by status. Paginated with cursor.

cursor.description: Pass meta.next_cursor of the previous page to get the next one.

tools.name: preview_conversion
tools.description: Step 1 of converting assets held on the account into USDT. The balance is kept in USDT (every payment is credited in USDT), so this matters only for an account that still holds another asset; to exchange USDT into another coin, send a payout in that coin (preview_payout, e.g. to your own address). mode "single": convert amount of from_asset_id (to USDT, or to to_asset_id); mode "all_to_usdt": convert every non-USDT holding to USDT. Returns preview_id with the amounts and expires_at; nothing moves yet. Then create_conversion.

from_asset_id.description: Required for mode "single". Public asset code from list_assets (its asset_id field), e.g. "usdt" (USDT TRC20), "btc", "eth", "xmr", "usdc_eth".

to_asset_id.description: Target asset (default USDT). Public asset code from list_assets (its asset_id field), e.g. "usdt" (USDT TRC20), "btc", "eth", "xmr", "usdc_eth".

amount_atomic.description: Amount in the smallest units of the asset (alternative to amount). Give exactly one of amount and amount_atomic.

external_id.description: Your own reference (order id); unique per account.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The same key returns the same result instead of a duplicate (safe retries); generated when omitted.

tools.name: create_conversion
tools.description: Step 2: executes a preview_conversion quote before its expires_at; the balance changes at once. A preview runs once — calling again returns the same conversion.

tools.name: get_conversion
tools.description: One conversion with its status and amounts.

tools.name: list_conversions
tools.description: Conversions of the account, newest first. Paginated with cursor.

cursor.description: Pass meta.next_cursor of the previous page to get the next one.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: Webhook endpoints of the account: endpoint_id, url, events, status.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Registers a public HTTPS URL that receives a POST for each chosen event (JSON {id, type, created_at, data}). Returns secret (shown once): verify each delivery with HMAC-SHA256 of "<Webhook-Timestamp>.<raw body>" against the Webhook-Signature header ("v1=<hex>"). Deliveries are at-least-once — dedupe by Webhook-Id. Up to 10 endpoints.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Replaces the url and events of an endpoint, or disables/enables it (status).

tools.name: rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description: Issues a new signing secret for an endpoint (shown once); the old one stops working at once.

instructions:
SnapEX Pay lets you accept, send and exchange crypto as a merchant account. Without an API key only create_account and the catalogue tools (list_assets, get_fiat_rates, get_fees, list_static_address_networks) work.
1. No key yet? Call create_account once (no captcha, no person needed). The new key is used on this connection automatically; save api_key and use it next time as "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" (or the returned mcp_personal_url).
2. Receive: create_invoice → give pay_url to the payer (or select_invoice_payment_method for a raw address) → get_invoice until status "paid". Use environment "test" first: no real money. Permanent top-up addresses: create_static_address.
3. Balance: get_balances (credited in USDT).
4. Send: preview_payout → check to_amount, fee, address → create_payout with the preview_id and your own idempotency_key (irreversible). Track with get_payout.
5. Exchange: the balance is USDT; to get another coin, pay out in that coin (step 4). preview_conversion → create_conversion turns other assets an older account holds into USDT.
Amounts are decimal strings ("12.5"). Asset codes come from list_assets. Errors explain what to do next. Docs: resource snapex://docs/quickstart, https://pay.snapex.pro/mcp
